Definition: properly, to (be) compact; by implication, to hoard
BiblicalUsage: Chacan means to hoard, to lay up treasure. Isaiah says the merchandise of Tyre will be holiness to the LORD: it will not be treasured nor laid up, but given for food and fine clothing to those who dwell before Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wealth hoarded is wealth wasted, and wealth given to God feeds His people.
